talking_points: Microsoft finally revealed Azure pulled in $33.2bn last quarter, nudging ahead of Google Cloud in the race to rent out AI computing power.
Alphabet's shares fell 10% after free cash flow turned sharply negative, a warning sign that the AI spending boom is starting to squeeze even the biggest tech balance sheets.
Big Canadian banks are locking third-party AI agents out of online banking over fraud fears, just as Anthropic faces questions from a senator and a famous short-seller ahead of its IPO.
